definitions.gloss: minor role; bit part; supporting role
definitions.explanation: A small, unimportant role in a play, film, or drama — one with few lines and little screen time. By extension, can describe a marginal or insignificant position in any endeavor.

examples.japanese: {端役|はやく}でも{出演|しゅつえん}できてうれしい。
examples.english: I'm happy even to appear in a minor role.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{端役|はやく}から{主役|しゅやく}にまで{成長|せいちょう}した。
examples.english: She grew from bit parts all the way to leading roles.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{俳優|はいゆう}でも{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}は{端役|はやく}ばかりだったそうだ。
examples.english: Even famous actors apparently had nothing but minor roles when they were young.

notes:
Compound of {端|は} ('edge; margin; peripheral') and {役|やく} ('role; part'). The word evokes a position at the margins of the main action — someone who appears briefly without driving the story.

USAGE:
- Primarily used in theater, film, and television contexts
- Can be used figuratively to describe a person playing an insignificant part in a project or event
- Often contrasted with {主役|しゅやく} ('leading role') or {大役|たいやく} ('important role')
- The story arc of rising from {端役|はやく} to stardom is a common narrative in entertainment industry stories

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端役|はやく}を{演|えん}じる: to play a minor role
- {端役|はやく}ばかり: nothing but minor roles
- {端役|はやく}から{始|はじ}める: to start from minor roles
- {端役|はやく}{俳優|はいゆう}: bit-part actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脇役|わきやく}: supporting role — a more significant secondary role that contributes to the plot, unlike the marginal {端役|はやく}
- {主役|しゅやく}: leading role; protagonist — the antonym; the central role in a production
- エキストラ: extra — a background performer with no lines, even smaller than a {端役|はやく}
